required: directed acyclic composition from input toward output
multiple parameterized aggregation or affine-mixing sites
at least one non-affine transformation on an internal path
reuse of the same generic aggregation/nonlinearity construction across more than one internal unit or stage
posthoc_fingerprint.learning_extension: if learning is claimed, experience updates distributed numeric parameters and alters future mapping

exclusions_near_neighbors: pure affine map with no nonlinearity
literal lookup table
family name or neuron/layer macro supplied to search
minimum_observation_tests: intervene on at least two incoming signals and show aggregation dependence
show non-affine response witness
show acyclic multi-stage composition
families.equivalence_scope: structural-mechanism fingerprint plus protected I/O capability; not exact historical implementation identity

required: persistent internal state survives between external steps
prior internal state causally changes a later output or update under matched current input
the state is updated and fed into subsequent computation

exclusions_near_neighbors: pure feed-forward mapping
write-only passive memory not read by later control
state label supplied as target macro
minimum_observation_tests: same current input with different reachable prior internal states produces different protected response
demonstrate at least one state-update cycle
families.equivalence_scope: stateful causal mechanism, not specific RNN equations

required: a common transform or parameter set is applied at multiple positions/sites
each application is restricted to a registered local neighborhood or receptive field
consistent relabeling/translation of sites transports the local computation where the registered domain supports it

exclusions_near_neighbors: independent unrelated parameters at every site
global all-to-all transform with no locality
convolution/local operator supplied as primitive macro
minimum_observation_tests: same local pattern at two sites induces the same local transform under matched boundary conditions
remote non-neighbor perturbation has no one-step effect at a tested local site
families.equivalence_scope: shared local mechanism; does not require literal convolution implementation
parent_anchors: LeCun et al. 1998 gradient-based document recognition / convolutional networks

required: a query/current-content-dependent compatibility or routing quantity is computed for multiple candidate sources
source influence on the aggregate changes when query/content changes
selected or weighted source information is aggregated into a downstream computation

exclusions_near_neighbors: fixed content-independent mixing
static hard-wired routing
attention/softmax/query-key-value macro supplied to search
minimum_observation_tests: hold sources fixed and change query/content to change source influence
show at least two candidate sources can dominate under different registered inputs
families.equivalence_scope: content-dependent routing/weighting mechanism; normalization need not be softmax unless claimed
parent_anchors: Vaswani et al. 2017 Attention Is All You Need

required: machine state contains explicitly compositional discrete expressions/terms/structures
legal transformations include rule-based rewrite/inference over those structures
control selects among more than one legal symbolic successor or derivation path

exclusions_near_neighbors: opaque numeric vector with no registered symbolic semantics
fixed finite lookup with no compositional rewrite
symbolic solver macro supplied whole
minimum_observation_tests: trace at least one semantics-preserving or goal-directed multi-step rewrite
show alternative legal symbolic successors from one structure

required: internal predictive/belief object is a normalized probability distribution or equivalent probabilistic state
registered evidence changes that object according to a declared probabilistic model
predictions/decisions are computed from the updated probabilistic state

exclusions_near_neighbors: unnormalized arbitrary score vector with no probabilistic semantics
randomized action with no maintained belief
Bayes operator supplied as an opaque target macro
minimum_observation_tests: normalization check
evidence-update likelihood-ratio or Bayes-equivalent check at finite scope
posterior/predictive response changes under informative evidence
families.equivalence_scope: probabilistic belief-update semantics; exact Bayesian identity required only where family claim says Bayesian
parent_anchors: Pearl 1988 Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems

required: candidate future action/state consequences or value-to-go quantities are evaluated before committing the current external action
choice depends on predicted downstream consequence rather than current immediate score alone
registered transition/control semantics connect action choices across more than one step

exclusions_near_neighbors: pure reactive policy with no future-consequence computation
fixed action sequence
planner macro supplied as a primitive
minimum_observation_tests: construct an immediate-reward trap where the selected action changes because of later consequence
trace the internal multi-step or value-recursive calculation
families.equivalence_scope: lookahead/dynamic-programming/control-equivalent mechanism, not one named planning algorithm
parent_anchors: Bellman dynamic programming / principle of optimality

required: multiple persistent stored items or records coexist
a later query/key/content state selects or weights stored content non-uniformly
retrieved content causally affects a downstream protected response

exclusions_near_neighbors: single undifferentiated recurrent hidden state
write-only archive
fixed-address read independent of query/content when content-addressed retrieval is claimed
minimum_observation_tests: same store with two different queries retrieves different registered items/content
remove or alter selected memory and change protected response
families.equivalence_scope: selective persistent retrieval mechanism; may be associative, keyed or content-addressed

required: at least two candidate organizations or heritable descriptions coexist in a population/set
new candidates are generated by registered variation from existing candidate information
evaluation/selection changes which candidate information persists or reproduces across iterations

exclusions_near_neighbors: single-candidate deterministic local search with no population/heredity
pure random restart with no inherited selected information
genetic/evolution operator supplied as a family macro
minimum_observation_tests: trace parent-to-descendant information inheritance
show evaluation changes next-generation representation frequencies or membership
families.equivalence_scope: population/heredity/variation/selection search mechanism; not literal biological genetics
parent_anchors: Holland Adaptation in Natural and Artificial Systems

required: search candidates are executable expressions/programs drawn from a declared language or grammar
a semantic/formal behavioral specification is used to accept/reject or score candidates
the returned artifact is itself an executable program/expression rather than only tuned numeric parameters

exclusions_near_neighbors: ordinary parameter fitting with fixed program structure
manual program construction
target program template that already determines the held-out mechanism
minimum_observation_tests: execute the synthesized artifact on protected tests
show at least two syntactically different candidate programs were in the legal search set
families.equivalence_scope: program/expression synthesis from specification; grammar bias remains explicit

required: the system proposes or effects a persistent change to its own organization, representation language, search/proposal law or reusable operator/library
the changed object is used in later control/search rather than only stored as inert history
the before/after mechanism is causally linked through a registered development/adoption transition

exclusions_near_neighbors: ordinary transient working-state update
external replacement with no machine-linked development path
self-modification macro that directly installs the target solution
minimum_observation_tests: replay same external situation before/after and expose mechanism/search-law difference
show the persistent change is inherited into a later step/task
families.equivalence_scope: persistent self/developmental mechanism change; governance/verification properties are separately scored unless claimed
